defendant: 86 Seadrift LLC a/k/a 86 Seadrift LLC, et al.
description:
Shaun Golden
MONMOUNTY COUNTY SHERIFF
NOTICE OF FORECLOSURE SALE
SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
MONMOUTH COUNTY
CHANCERY DIVISION
Docket No. F00658825
Sheriff’s File # 26000304
PLAINTIFF – EF Mortgage LLC, vs:
DEFENDANTS- 86 Seadrift LLC a/k/a 86 Seadrift LLC, et al.
By virtue of a writ of execution in the above stated action to me directed, I shall expose for sale at public vendue, at Monmouth County Sheriff’s Office Public Safety Center, 2500 Kozloski Road, in the township of Freehold, county of Monmouth, New Jersey, on
Monday, the 11th day of May,
at 1 o’clock, P.M. prevailing time. The property to be sold is located in Highlands, in the County of Monmouth, State of New Jersey.
Lot Block Number if available: Lot and Block: Lot 2, Block 74 Tax Map of Borough of Highlands
COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
86 Seadrift Avenue Highlands, NJ 07732
Occupancy Status: Tenant Occupied
Nearest Cross Street: Approximately 100.00ft from the nearest cross street known as Bay Avenue
Approximate Dimensions: 25.00ft x 70.00ft x 25.00ft x 70.00ft
Property is also being sold: Limited to tangible property located on 86 Seadrift Avenue, Highlands, New Jersey 07732 owned by 86 Seadrift LLC a/k/a 86 Seadrift LLC, a New Jersey-NJ Limited Liability Company
The full legal description can be found in the Office of the Clerk of Monmouth County in Deed Book OR-9676, at Page 8376
Approximate Upset Price is $392,255.14 for the Sheriff's sale
Pursuant to a municipal tax search dated February 5, 2026.
Subject to: 2025 Taxes, $5,942.25 billed; $3,380.47 Open Plus Penalty; $2,561.78 Paid
2026 1st quarter taxes due 2/1/2026, $1,485.57 Open; Subject to posting
2026 2nd quarter taxes due 5/1/2026, $1,485.56 Open
Sewer: Acct. 6090 0, 1/1/2026-3/31/2026, $140.00 open and due 2/13/2026; $559.82 Open Plus Penalty; Owed in arrears
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
A full legal description of the premises can be found in the Office of The Sheriff of Monmouth County.
TERMS OF SALE: DEPOSIT: 20% of the bid amount at the time of sale. Balance due in 30 days. Cash (with a limit of $1,000.00) or cashier’s check only.
The approximate judgment amount is the sum of $387,203.38.
The judgment amount may be subject to further Orders of additional sums. The successful bidder will be responsible for all fees, commissions and costs of sale.
The Sheriff hereby reserves the right to adjourn this sale without further notice by publication.
Shaun Golden, Sheriff
DATED: February 25, 2026
Hill Wallack LLP
21 Roszel Road
PO Box 5226
Princeton, NJ 08540
609-924-0808
